game_title: Pattern Painter – Hollow Log Trail Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail, a trail through hollow logs: the wood elf archer must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Pattern Painter: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the mushroom ring.
theme: Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail: a trail through hollow logs
core_gameplay_loop: In Hollow Log Trail, repeat each round: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the mushroom ring. Each round, cursed treants strike the mushroom ring, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the pattern_rows value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the mushroom ring from cursed treants in Hollow Log Trail: keep the pattern_rows meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: pattern_rows drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Pattern Painter
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
